definition: Either of a pair of long, thin sensory appendages on the heads of insects, crustaceans, and some other arthropods
examples: The ant used its antenna to sense the environment around it.

definition: The circumstances or situation prevailing at a particular time or underlying a particular event
examples: The book explains the historical background of the scientific discovery.

definition: A bird's horny projecting jaws; a bill
examples: The bird carried a small twig in its sharp beak.

definition: A curved pointed horny nail on each digit of the foot in birds, lizards, and some mammals
examples: The cat sharpened its claws on the wooden post.

definition: To establish the truth or correctness of something previously believed or suspected to be the case
examples: New experiments confirm the scientist's original theory.

definition: To discover or identify the presence or existence of something
examples: Dogs can detect scents that humans are completely unable to smell.

definition: To produce and discharge something, especially gas, sound, or radiation
examples: Fireflies emit a soft glow in the dark to attract mates.

definition: A large sharp tooth, especially a canine tooth of a dog or wolf, or a venomous tooth of a snake
examples: The wolf bared its sharp fangs and growled.

definition: Any of the flat appendages growing from a bird's skin and forming its plumage
examples: She found a bright blue peacock feather on the ground.

definition: A flattened appendage on various parts of the body of many aquatic vertebrates, used for propelling and steering
examples: We spotted the dorsal fin of a dolphin cutting through the waves.

definition: The short, fine, soft hair of certain animals
examples: The polar bear's thick white fur keeps it warm in freezing temperatures.

definition: A unit of heredity which is transferred from a parent to offspring and is held to determine some characteristic of the offspring
examples: Eye color is determined by the specific genes you inherit from your parents.

definition: A domesticated tailless South American rodent, often kept as a pet or used in biological research
examples: She keeps a small brown and white guinea pig as a pet.

definition: The horny part of the foot of an ungulate animal, especially a horse
examples: The blacksmith checked the horse's front hoof for any stones.

definition: A hard permanent outgrowth, often curved and pointed, found in pairs on the heads of cattle, sheep, goats, and other animals
examples: The mountain goat has two long, curved horns on its head.

definition: Information discovered as the result of an inquiry or research
examples: The scientists published the findings of their study in a medical journal.

definition: To pursue and kill a wild animal for sport or food
examples: Owls come out at night to hunt for mice and other small animals.

definition: The bodily system that protects the body from foreign substances, cells, and tissues by producing an immune response
examples: A balanced diet and good sleep help strengthen your immune system.

definition: In a comprehensive and thorough way
examples: We will study the behavior of marine mammals in depth during the course.

definition: To discover the exact place or position of something
examples: Bats use echolocation to locate insects in the dark.

definition: The sexual partner of a bird or other animal
examples: Swans are famous for choosing a single mate for life.

definition: To travel on a desired course after planning a route
examples: Migrating birds use the sun and stars to navigate across continents.

definition: An animal's young
examples: The mother bear fiercely protects her offspring from any danger.

definition: An essay or dissertation read at a seminar or published in an academic journal
examples: The biologist wrote a research paper on the migration patterns of whales.

definition: An animal's foot having claws and pads
examples: The dog lifted its front paw to shake hands.

definition: Evidence or argument establishing or helping to establish a fact or the truth of a statement
examples: The fossils provided clear proof that the area was once underwater.

definition: To allow a substance to flow out from somewhere; to set free
examples: Plants release oxygen into the atmosphere during photosynthesis.

definition: Each of the small, thin horny or bony plates protecting the skin of fish and reptiles
examples: The fish had shiny silver scales that reflected the sunlight.

definition: The hard protective outer case of a mollusk, crustacean, or turtle
examples: The turtle pulled its head and legs inside its hard shell.

definition: To draw up air audibly through the nose to detect a smell
examples: The dog stopped to sniff the grass along the footpath.

definition: The hindmost part of an animal, especially when prolonged beyond the rest of the body
examples: The puppy wagged its tail excitedly when we came home.

definition: To perceive or experience the flavor of something
examples: Butterflies actually taste leaves with their feet to see if they are good to lay eggs on.

definition: To move continuously and rapidly to and fro
examples: Spiders can feel the threads of their web vibrate when an insect is caught.

definition: A long projecting hair or bristle growing from the face or snout of many mammals
examples: A cat uses its sensitive whiskers to judge whether it can fit through tight spaces.

definition: Any of a number of specialized paired appendages that enable some animals, especially birds and insects, to fly
examples: The eagle spread its wide wings and soared high above the valley.
